label: Seeding is doubly silent: the function only runs when spec.md still contains the exact first placeholder line, and the perl replacement only fires on the exact four-line placeholder block, so a partially customized block either skips the function or matches nothing — both paths print nothing and leave placeholders that are only ever reported as template-default warnings.

Non-English descriptions are stripped to an empty phrase by the tr channel, and default phase-child scaffolds seed generic 'phase N' phrases (2-4 tokens, no sentence punctuation) that pass every judge negative class; the sanitizer's phase-N rule has no consumer on the creation path, so nothing rejects them and the index reads them straight from frontmatter.

The template-default class is robust to case and separator variants but blind to concatenated variants such as 'feature specification and problem statement', rejects non-English phrases under a misleading generic-workflow-word class instead of an empty class, gives very short descriptions no value floor (one token only warns, two generic tokens pass), and is warning-only like every other class.

No backfill executor exists for spec-packet trigger phrases — the only corpus migrator is scoped to memory files; the safe path is an operator-run, dry-run-first batch tool cloning that contract (atomic writes, before/after phrase hashes, 200-file safety limit, manual-phrase preservation) that rewrites only judge-classed placeholders, then regenerates derived metadata and the trigger index and closes with validate.sh --strict.

Trigger-phrase quality is advisory at every layer: the seeder may no-op, the judge only classifies, the validator only warns, and no trigger-phrase defect may fail create.sh or a validation run; hardening must live in warnings, stderr notes and quality counters.

direction: Renaming the four template placeholder phrases so the seeding block cannot drift
reason: The placeholder bytes are consumed by three unvalidated dependencies (template text, the create.sh grep gate and exact block, the judge's TEMPLATE_DEFAULT_PHRASES set), so a rename would reproduce the same coupling under new strings; robustness belongs at seed time and in the judge's classes, not in a template rename.
